object.JunimoNote.name: Leafwhisper Note
object.JunimoNote.description: A worn parchment, penned by the Junimos. This guide offers comprehension of a valley creature. Handle it gently; the Junimos' wisdom is delicate as dew on a sun-kissed leaf.
object.OsirisScroll.name: Eternal Glyphs of Osiris
object.OsirisScroll.description: A timeworn papyrus scroll, its edges frayed and ink faded. The hieroglyphs depict the ancient ritual that binds the mummies to an eternal cycle—death, unwinding, and rebirth.
mail.MarnieThanks: Dear @,^^I wanted to say a big thank you for the wild eggs you left in my barrel.^^I tried my best, but I couldn't get the eggs to hatch. I think they've been out in the wild for too long. Maybe you could take one of the bigger ones to the man in the tower and see if he can work his magic on it.^^Thanks again for your kindness, @. Your friendship means a lot to me.^^Warmly, Marnie
mail.WizardThanks: @,^^Your assistance with the eggs and the items you provided are invaluable. Your efforts have brought me closer to unlocking the secrets of the ancient art of awakening.^However, my research has led me to a new discovery that again requires your assistance. I am in need of a powerful artifact known as the Eternal Glyphs of Osiris, a magic scroll guarded by a powerful mummy in the desert.^I entrust you with this perilous task. Be cautious, the mummy's ability to amplify the strength of its allies makes it a formidable foe. If you manage to retrieve the Eternal Glyphs of Osiris, we shall finally succeed in our efforts.^^-M. Rasmodius, Wizard
mail.WizardFindings: Young @,^^I am thrilled to inform you that, with the junimos' assistance and guided by the scroll instructions, I have successfully created a special essence capable of nurturing the wild eggs. I have included in this letter instructions on how to craft it.^I will also report my findings to Marnie to keep her informed of our progress.^Thank you for your invaluable assistance in this endeavor. May the wonders of the valley continue to unfold before us.^^ -M. Rasmodius, Wizard
mail.MarnieIncubator: Dear @,^^I hope you're doing well! I have some exciting news to share. The Wizard contacted me with some instructions, and with my animal knowledge and Robin's help, we've created a special incubator for wild eggs.^This incubator is unique—it will even produce a note with the animal's info each time a new animal hatches for the first time. Would you be a dear and help me expand my livestock by sharing the note? I'd be happy to pay for it!^Thanks again for your help in all of this. You're such a good neighbor!^^-Marnie
mail.animalAvaliable0: Dear @,^^Thanks a bunch for the note! The tips about the animal were really useful.^The animals are thriving and have settled in nicely. I've been able to reproduce them, and they're now available in my shop.^If you ever need anything or have more notes, just give me a shout.^^Best, Marnie
mail.animalAvaliable1: Hi @,^^Just wanted to say thanks for the great note! The information was spot on.^The animals are doing great and have adapted perfectly. I've even managed to reproduce them, and they're now up for sale in my shop.^If you have any more notes or need anything, feel free to reach out.^Cheers!^- Marnie^^^
mail.animalAvaliable2: Hey @,^^Thanks for the note! The information about the animal was super helpful.^I'm excited to tell you that the animals have settled in really well. I was able to reproduce them, and now they're available in my shop for everyone.^If you ever discover new animals or need anything, please let me know.^^Thanks again!^- Marnie^^^
quest.WizardStudy.title: Wizard Wild Eggs Study
quest.WizardStudy.questDetails: Marnie thinks you should ask the Wizard for help with the wild eggs.
quest.WizardStudy.hint: Deliver 1 Large Wild Egg to the Wizard.
quest.WizardStudy.reactionText: Ah, you've brought the egg as I foresaw.#$b# I'll take a look. The junimos might be able to help me with this.#$b# If I need anything else, I'll let you know. Just check the special order board in a couple of days.#$b# Now, if you'll excuse me...
quest.NoteDelivery.title: Note Delivery
quest.NoteDelivery.questDetails: Marnie has asked for the Leafwhisper Note
quest.NoteDelivery.reactionText0: Oh, how wonderful! This note is just what I needed.$h#$b#I can't wait to find this egg and welcome a new friend to my farm. Thank you so much for your help!$h#$b#
quest.NoteDelivery.reactionText1: What delightful news! This information will be so helpful.$h#$b#I'm excited to go find this egg and expand my farm. Thanks a bunch for thinking of me!$h#$b#
quest.NoteDelivery.reactionText2: Fantastic! This note is perfect. I'll head out to find this egg right away.$h#$b#It's always a joy to add a new member to my farm. I really appreciate your assistance!$h#$b#
quest.NoteDelivery.reactionText3: Oh, that's marvelous! This note will guide me to the egg, and I can't wait to see what hatches.$h#$b#Thank you for being so thoughtful and helping me grow my farm!$h#$b#
quest.NoteDelivery.reactionText_AnimalIn: It says this about this animal:
quest.TheDesertScroll.title: The Desert Scroll
quest.TheDesertScroll.questDetails: The Wizard has asked for the Eternal Glyphs of Osiris, which can be obtained by defeating a powerful mummy in the desert.
quest.TheDesertScroll.hint: Deliver to The Wizard the Eternal Glyphs of Osiris
quest.TheDesertScroll.reactiontext: Ah, you have returned with the Eternal Glyphs of Osiris! Excellent work, young @.#$b#These glyphs hold immense power, and their ancient knowledge will guide our ritual.#$h#The intricate rituals to awaken their latent energies will take a few days to complete.#$b#I will inform you once the awakening is complete. Until then, may the spirits of the valley guide you.#$b
specialOrder.WildEggIncubatorI.name: Wild Eggs Collecting
specialOrder.WildEggIncubatorI.text: I've been hearing whispers about some wild eggs scattered throughout the valley. I'd love to collect a few of these eggs for my animal sanctuary. Could you lend me a hand? I'll make it worth your while!   -Marnie
specialOrder.WildEggIncubatorI.objective: Deliver 5 wild eggs to the barril in the forest.
specialOrder.WildEggIncubatorII.name: Dormant Awakening
specialOrder.WildEggIncubatorII.text: I've been studying how to awaken dormant eggs. To unlock their potential, I require some items. Bring them to me, and I shall unravel the mysteries of their awakening!   -M. Rasmodius, Wizard
specialOrder.WildEggIncubatorII.objectiv: Deliver 1 Ancient Seed to the Wizard.
This dry, seemingly lifeless relic holds a spark of primal energy, waiting to be reignited. Its ancient power is crucial to awakening the dormant forces within.
Deliver 1 Ancient Fruit to the Wizard.
This rare, seemingly timeless fruit holds a spark of primal energy, waiting to be reignited. Its ancient power is crucial to awakening the dormant forces within.
Deliver 1 Woodskip Roe to the Wizard.
These Woodskip's delicate eggs are infused with the forest's magic. This connection is vital to amplifying the essence of the wild eggs.
Deliver 1 Dinosaur Egg to the Wizard.
This intact, giant relic from a bygone era holds the secrets of a long-lost world. Its ancient majesty and power are essential to the quest.
